senses.definition: n.m. region across, beyond (v. BH I. עֵ֫בֶר, √ עָבַר);—cstr. in phr. עֲבַר(־)נַהֲרָה, i.e. Syria (Scheft 87): Ezr 4:10, 11, 17, 20; 5:3, 6(×2); 6:6(×2), 8, 13; 7:21, 25, ע׳ נהרא 4:16. cf. in Cilic. Aramaic, Cooke 346.
